results.name: ROT-PARITY-01 legacy history (no snapshots) reproduces the legacy counter for 0..40 complete B
ROT-PARITY-02 legacy history ignores drafts and non-B like the legacy counter
ROT-PARITY-03 fully performed new-era sessions follow the legacy sequence 0,1,2,0,1,2 (property, 200 random lengths and pre-era offsets)
ROT-SKIP-01 a completed B that skipped the presented intensifiers does not advance rotation
ROT-SKIP-02 skipping is not repeated forever: lapse advances the group after 2 finished uncredited presentations
ROT-PART-01 a partially completed intensifier (incomplete record) earns no credit
ROT-PART-02 credit policy: one of two slots performed credits under "any" and not under "all"
ROT-COMPACT-01 compact/time-constrained B whose presented slots were hidden or run straight earns no credit
ROT-DRAFT-01 an interrupted draft with performed intensifier earns credit once, and resuming does not double-count
ROT-DRAFT-02 an abandoned draft without records neither credits nor counts toward lapse
ROT-DUP-01 duplicate sessions or duplicate records (for example after a merged restore) do not double-credit
ROT-HIST-01 derivation never mutates its inputs (history, records, sessions)
ROT-NOMETHOD-01 a presented group with no non-straight method credits on completion (cannot stall)
ROT-MANUAL-01 manual intensifier override on a slot outside the presented group earns no credit
ROT-MIX-01 pre-era history followed by new-era sessions is seamless
